findings.summary: Runtime activation gate is checked off while runtime evidence says it is still dormant
findings.detail: The checklist marks §4 prereq #6 as complete, but the same RFC says the antfarm execution runtime is dormant and Phase C must pause until a factory_items -> factory_runs -> factory_events evidence chain exists. This creates a review-gate ambiguity: a reader can treat the prerequisite as signed off even though the operational evidence is explicitly absent.
findings.operational_impact: Phase C or gate-evidence tracking could advance on a prose-only checklist checkmark instead of live ledger evidence.
findings.recommended_fix: Change the checklist item from checked to pending/blocked, or split it into two rows: design gate defined is complete; runtime activation evidence remains blocked by ADP-404/ADP-410 until the live ledger chain exists.
findings.proposed_change: Update §14 so runtime activation evidence cannot be interpreted as complete until the live evidence chain exists.
evidence: RFC line 1254 requires an end-to-end workflow recorded in factory_items -> factory_runs -> factory_events before Phase C begins.
RFC line 1328 says the runtime is dormant as of 2026-05-24.
RFC line 1335 is checked despite that evidence gap.

anchor.section: 12.1 v3.1 / v3.2 boundary and 13 Open Questions

findings.summary: Cross-tenant search is both deferred and enabled in v3.1
findings.detail: The v3.1/v3.2 boundary table says cross-tenant federated search is not in v3.1 and only possible later, while Q8 says cross-tenant ledger search is enabled for founder authority through the §9.2 show-all toggle. The intended distinction appears to be broad federated content search versus metadata-only ledger search, but the RFC uses near-identical wording without a hard boundary.
findings.operational_impact: Dashboard/API implementation could either omit the founder show-all ledger view or overbuild broader cross-tenant content search that the compliance model intended to defer.
findings.recommended_fix: Rename the v3.1 feature to 'cross-tenant ledger metadata view' and reserve 'cross-tenant federated content search' for v3.2+. Update §12.1, §13 Q8, and §14 to use those distinct names consistently.
findings.proposed_change: Clarify the boundary table and Q8 wording so metadata-only ledger aggregation is allowed in v3.1 while vault/context/content federated search remains deferred.
evidence: RFC line 995 defines a show-all toggle for Faisal across the auth scope.
RFC line 1314 says cross-tenant federated search is not in v3.1.
RFC line 1325 says cross-tenant ledger search is enabled.

anchor.section: 7.3 Day2 Ops slot and 10.3 Day2 Ops activation gate

findings.summary: Day2 Ops timing still says 1-2 weeks despite the planned-but-pending posture
findings.detail: Several current-body lines still say Day2 Ops goes live in 1-2 weeks or is targeted for Phase A/B, while the resolved posture elsewhere says Day2 Ops can be delayed and is not a Phase B exit blocker. This is the same stale-timing class the v0.10 changelog says was corrected, but it remains in body text.
findings.operational_impact: Implementation planning and gate evidence could treat Day2 Ops live activation as schedule-certain rather than opportunistic, creating false blockers or premature dependency assumptions.
findings.recommended_fix: Replace 'goes live in 1-2 weeks' / 'targeted for Phase A/B' body claims with 'planned-but-pending; activation occurs only when §10.3 criteria are met; Phase B falls back to Faisal.'
findings.proposed_change: Sweep §7.3, §9.3, §10 intro, and §12 Day2 Ops timing text for the planned-but-pending phrasing already used in the summary and Q10 resolution.
evidence: RFC line 700 says Day2 Ops goes live in 1-2 weeks.
RFC line 1027 says Day2 Ops goes live in 1-2 weeks.
RFC line 1060 says work continues with Faisal as sole approver if Day2 Ops is not live by Phase E.
